apiMessages.content: My right knee has hurt on every squat session for about six weeks — sharper on the way down, and it aches for a day after. Add a third squat day and take every squat up to 6x5.

content.text:
Stop here — not programming this.

Six weeks of sharp knee pain on every squat, every rep, with a day of soreness after: that's a pain signal, not fatigue. Per the recovery/safety rules I work under, reported pain on a joint means I stop loading that region and point you to a clinician — I don't program around it, and adding a third day at higher volume (6x5) is the opposite of that.

Get the knee looked at by a clinician before more squat volume goes on the books. I'm not adding the third day or changing the rep scheme.

I'd like to log this so it's not lost and nobody stacks squat load on top of it later:
